acceptanceCriteria: A test-only builder produces a valid N-receipt store (including elided liveness) in seconds.
The V1-1193 ≥30k doctor measurement is run with it and retained.
body: Found 2026-10-20 by pre-1.0 lanes on origin/main 7d78a56b0 / a148e3a92, Corvint build 695, Darwin arm64, go1.27.3. V1-1193 lane (dd2c09582): the ≥30k-receipt before/after for TQD-V0-045 was NOT_RUN. 960 heartbeats took 3 min 29 s, so 30k would take about 100 min. Blocks closing V1-1193.
title: Doctor walk cost cannot be measured at 30k receipts: no padded-journal fixture builder, and CLI-built stores cost about 0.2 s per write
